summary: The Flavor and Extract Manufacturers Association (FEMA) of the United States was founded in 1909 by several flavor firms responding to the Pure Food and Drug Act of 1906. The note lists its eight founding member companies. It is a short note with no further detail on the association's later activities.
one_line: FEMA, a US flavor and extract trade group, was founded in 1909 by eight flavor firms after the Pure Food and Drug Act of 1906.
key_facts: The Flavor and Extract Manufacturers Association (FEMA) of the United States was founded in 1909.
FEMA was founded by several flavor firms in response to the passage of the Pure Food and Drug Act of 1906.
Founding members of FEMA included McCormick & Company.
Founding members of FEMA included Ulman Driefus & Company.
Founding members of FEMA included Jones Brothers.
Founding members of FEMA included Blanke Baer Chemical Company.
Founding members of FEMA included Frank Tea & Spice Company.
Founding members of FEMA included Foote & Jenkes.
Founding members of FEMA included Sherer Gillett Company.
Founding members of FEMA included C.F. Sauer Company.
